name: Air fryer garlic herb salmon
steps: Microwave butter in small bowl for 5 to 10 seconds
Combine and mix butter garlic basil
Salt and pepper all sides of salmon
Add salmon and pour over butter mixture and place lemon on top
Squeeze remaining lemon from top of salmon and discard it

name: Roasted Berry Oats
description: A make-ahead breakfast with jammy berries and a toasted oat topping.
steps: Heat the oven and add the berries to a small baking dish.
Stir the oats, milk, maple syrup, and cinnamon together.
Spoon the oat mixture over the berries.
Bake until the topping is golden and the berries are bubbling.
